title: ProductSubscription and EntitlementProjection
description: ProductSubscription answers exactly one question: which ProductVersion, with which additional profiles/add-ons, has this tenant subscribed to? It never grants capabilities directly -- nabhold/baobab-cp expands it into CapabilityGrant rows (capability/v1/grant.schema.json, source=PRODUCT_SUBSCRIPTION, source_reference=subscription_id), and EntitlementProjection is the read-model record of that expansion (Technical Specification SS31, SS91).

subscription_profiles.description: Additional profile/add-on compositions selected for this subscription beyond its ProductVersion's base composition, e.g. ["profile.b2b", "profile.crossborder", "profile.commodity-trade", "profile.supplier-management"] for the ZuriBeans acceptance fixture. Composition expansion (including includes_compositions) is a baobab-cp runtime responsibility, not encoded here.

source_reference.description: Opaque reference to the originating record, e.g. a contract_id when source=CONTRACT. Required whenever source is not ONBOARDING.

capability_key.description: One capability this subscription's composition graph expands to, per member criticality in composition.schema.json.

grant_id.description: The CapabilityGrant this projection materialised, once status=MATERIALIZED. Null while PENDING or FAILED.

failure_reason.description: Set only when status=FAILED, e.g. the composition member's capability_key is not registered.
